title: The bronchial tree and branches of the pulmonary artery (human, adult, posterior aspect) | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Resin corrosion cast of left and right lung. Posterior aspect of lower trachea (1, yellow) with two principal bronchi (yellow) with red-stained pulmonary artery (2) and its branching. The cast of both lung lobes reveals especially the intricate divisions and branching of the bronchial tree (yellow) as well as their close relation to their vascularisation (red).

title: Pseudoglandular - canalicular period of developing lung (human, fetus) | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Stain: Azan. Terminal budding and elongation of the future bronchial tree: branching of a bronchial tubes (1) within an islet where the mesenchyme condenses (4). A large blood vessel (2) as well as a lymph vessel (3) are recognizable. Note in the mesenchyme formation of blood capillaries in the vicinity of the bronchial tubes (↓).

title: Keratin 7 staining in squamous metaplasia of the epithelium of a bronchiolus (human, adult) | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Stain: anti-keratin 7 antibody (Pan-Ck 7) immunoperoxidase staining (with aminoethylcarbazole (AEC) substrate). A red-brown staining with AEC indicates a positive reaction for cytokeratin 7. Note that the top layer only is stained positively for keratin 7 (↓). Upon squamous metaplasia the bronchiolar epithelial cells reduce keratin 7 expression and hence this cytokeratin appears a suitable marker in the study of early metaplastic processes in epithelia e.g., the bronchial tree.
